scope: Miao Chapter 8 (pp. 231-290): option exercise and McCall search, discrete choice (replacement), consumption and saving with deterministic income (Theorem 8.3.1, Examples 8.3.1-8.3.2) and stochastic income (Lemmas 8.3.1-8.3.4, Propositions 8.3.1-8.3.2), consumption/portfolio choice, the (s, S) inventory model (Lemmas 8.5.1-8.5.6, Propositions 8.5.1-8.5.4), investment (neoclassical, Q theory and Hayashi, augmented adjustment costs, Example 8.6.1), and Exercises 1-9 and 11-14.
source: Jianjun Miao, Economic Dynamics in Discrete Time, MIT Press 2014 (draft of 21 April 2013), Chapter 8
